The '''Tarabba sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and contained the [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]], whose primary world was the sinkhole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The sector was located between the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra]] and [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sectors]].

==History==
The Utapau system was taken by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was freed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in time for the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-established]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to assume control of the sector.<ref name="Episode III" />
